verdict.rationale: Stripe Atlas includes a Delaware registered agent, so the appointment-coverage axis applies to it. The evidence never publishes per-state appointment details: no agent address for each state, no form that designates the agent, and no statement of who files it. Community reports say state- and city-level legwork outside Delaware is left to the founder.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, the provider publishes per-state appointment details: the agent address for that state, which form designates the agent, and who files it
